query: How do reasons for visit relate to urgency and visit duration across department and age group?

per_column.name: presentation_severity
per_column.rationale: Clean ordinal scale from asymptomatic/preventive to life-threatening with well-separated, well-populated categories. A human can segment visits by severity and compare duration/urgency directly.

per_column.name: symptom_type_primary
per_column.rationale: Interpretable nominal grouping of clinical system (cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, etc.). Categories are meaningful and reasonably populated, enabling comparison of duration across symptom types and departments.

per_column.name: intervention_urgency_level
per_column.rationale: Distinct, interpretable intervention tiers (routine diagnostic to immediate invasive). Segmentable and directly relevant to duration and to the urgency axis of the query, though somewhat overlapping with the existing urgency column.

per_column.name: medication_route_intensity
per_column.rationale: Ordinal-ish escalation of treatment intensity (none to IV resuscitation) with well-separated categories; an external correlate of duration that a human can group on meaningfully.

per_column.name: visit_context_type
per_column.rationale: Clear encounter-type categories (acute new, follow-up, preventive, exacerbation, post-procedural) that are balanced and highly interpretable; strong segmentation variable for duration and reason relationships.

per_column.name: acuity_signal
per_column.rationale: Dominated by 'not_present' (198 of ~250) with tiny sparse critical categories (4-19). Near-constant and too imbalanced for meaningful grouped comparison; also largely redundant with presentation_severity.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are genuine external, interpretable segmentation variables with well-separated, populated categories (severity, symptom type, intervention level, medication intensity, visit context) that let a human explorer group and compare against visit_duration_min alongside department and age group. They open informative relationships rather than restating the focus. Weaknesses: acuity_signal is near-constant and too sparse to compare, and there is notable conceptual overlap among the severity/urgency/acuity columns and with the existing urgency field, slightly reducing the distinct informativeness of the set.
